attchmntText: Accuracy Shipping Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Accuracy Shipping Limited submitted newspaper advertisements regarding its financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The advertisements were published in the Financial Express English All India Edition and the Gujarat Pravah Daily Gujarati on 08th November 2026. The information is also available on the company website at www.aslindia.net.

attchmntText: Accuracy Shipping Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Accuracy Shipping Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved the standalone and consolidated results on 07th November 2026. For the quarter ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 1,700.02 million rupees. Net profit was 3.39 million rupees. Earnings per share were 0.02 rupees. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, revenue from operations was 3,070.72 million rupees. Net profit was 8.99 million rupees. Earnings per share were 0.06 rupees. The company operates in logistics services, sale of commercial vehicles, and sale of petroleum products. The results were reviewed by Chartered Accountants Data and Co.
